description: Header file defining the 'byte_buffer' class and related utilities for managing non-contiguous byte sequences using linked list segments, including creation, copying, appending, slicing, and formatting functionalities within the 'ocudu' namespace.

classes.name: byte_buffer
classes.description: Represents a non-contiguous byte sequence managed via linked list segments, supporting creation, copying, appending, slicing, and formatting.

classes.name: byte_buffer_slice
classes.description: Represents a sub-interval or make_slice of a byte_buffer, sharing ownership of segments and supporting slicing and comparison.

classes.name: byte_buffer_reader
classes.description: Provides read-only access to bytes in a byte_buffer, supporting iteration and splitting.

classes.name: byte_buffer_writer
classes.description: Provides write access to a byte_buffer, supporting appending and zero-padding.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory methods to create byte_buffer instances from spans, initializer lists, or ranges.

methods.name: deep_copy
methods.description: Performs a deep copy of the byte_buffer, copying all bytes into new segments.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Performs a shallow copy, sharing ownership of segments.

methods.name: append
methods.description: Appends bytes, ranges, or other byte_buffers to the current buffer.

methods.name: prepend
methods.description: Prepends bytes or byte_buffers to the current buffer.

methods.name: linearize
methods.description: Consolidates segments into a single contiguous segment.

methods.name: resize
methods.description: Resizes the buffer length without initializing new bytes.

methods.name: segments
methods.description: Returns a range of segments composing the buffer.
